req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the task title exceeds the maximum length constraint. To ensure this behavior, we need to test the API with a title that is within the limit (positive case), exactly at the limit (boundary case), and exceeding the limit (negative case). This will help us verify that the system correctly enforces the title length constraint.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title_length
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of valid length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Valid Title", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Title"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_exceeding_title_length
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title exceeding the maximum length.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

long_title = "A" * 101  # Exceeds max length of 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": long_title, "description": "A task with a long title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title exactly at the maximum length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_title = "A" * 100  # Exactly max length
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": boundary_title, "description": "A task with a boundary title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == boundary_title
